interpretation: Trained and evaluated on the official UNSW-NB15 train/test split (a genuine generalisation test, not a random re-split of the same pool), the supervised detector transfers cleanly from the synthetic-log methodology in Section 3.1 to real network traffic. The unsupervised Isolation Forest, given no label access, still recovers a substantial share of real attacks from behavioural features alone - corroborating the same 'baseline deviation flags real threats' finding as the synthetic UBA module (Section 3.2) and the NASA real-telemetry module (Section 9), now on a third, independent real/hybrid data source.
